enchantments.tooltip: Spellcasting Implement +13: Passive: +13 Implement bonus to Universal Spell Power.
+5 Enhancement Bonus: +5 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.
Proficiency: Longsword: While equipped this item grants the wielder all required knowledge to wield a Longsword without proficiency penalties.
Devotion +87: Passive: +87 Equipment bonus to Positive (Healing) Spell Power.
Healing Lore +13: Passive: Your Positive Energy spells gain a 13% Equipment bonus to their chance to critical hit.
Quality Spell Focus Mastery +1: +1 Quality bonus to the DC of all spells.
Insightful Spell Penetration +3: Passive: +3 Insight bonus to Spell Penetration checks.
Mythic Weapon Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
